description: Source code for a decrypting media decoder implementation for Windows, involving DRM handling, sample creation, and integration with media foundation interfaces.

classes.name: DecryptingDecoder
classes.description: A class that handles decryption and decoding of media samples, managing DRM, decryptor activation, and sample processing.

methods.name: CreateSample
methods.description: Creates an IMFMediaSample from raw data and timestamp.

methods.name: AttachDrmDataToSample
methods.description: Attaches DRM-related data such as key ID, IV, and subsample mapping to an IMFMediaSample.

methods.name: TryWriteInputBuffer
methods.description: Attempts to write an input buffer into the decoder, handling DRM decryption if necessary.

methods.name: ProcessAndRead
methods.description: Processes available samples and reads output, managing decryptor and decoder states.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Drains the decoder and decryptor pipelines.

methods.name: ActivateDecryptor
methods.description: Activates and configures the decryptor, ensuring proper protection and type matching.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder and decryptor states, clearing internal buffers.
